```java
{
        GeminiClient client = mock(GeminiClient.class);
        VenueMapper mapper = mock(VenueMapper.class);
        ObjectMapper objectMapper = new ObjectMapper().findAndRegisterModules();
        Venue venue = mock(Venue.class);
        when(venue.getId()).thenReturn(UUID.randomUUID());
        when(venue.getName()).thenReturn("Sound Stage");
        when(venue.getHourlyRateEur()).thenReturn(new BigDecimal("175.00"));
        when(venue.getMinimumBookingMinutes()).thenReturn(240);
        when(venue.getMaxCrewSize()).thenReturn(30);
        when(venue.getPermittedActivities()).thenReturn(List.of(ProductionActivity.INTERVIEW));
        when(venue.getNaturalLight()).thenReturn(false);
        when(venue.getSoundRecordingSuitable()).thenReturn(true);
        when(venue.getProductionRules()).thenReturn("No smoke effects");
        when(venue.getPowerDetails()).thenReturn("3-phase power available");
        when(venue.getTags()).thenReturn(List.of("studio"));
        when(client.generateContent(anyString())).thenReturn("raw");
        when(client.extractGeneratedText("raw")).thenReturn("[]");

        ParsedBrief brief = ParsedBriefFixtures.fromJson("""
                {"requestedDate":"2026-08-25","requestedStartTime":"10:00:00",
                 "requestedEndTime":"16:00:00"}
                """);
        new GeminiVenueRanker(client, objectMapper, mapper)
                .rank("Interview", brief, List.of(venue));

        ArgumentCaptor<String> prompt = ArgumentCaptor.forClass(String.class);
        verify(client).generateContent(prompt.capture());
        assertThat(prompt.getValue())
                .contains("already passed all deterministic hard requirements")
                .contains("\"maxCrewSize\":30")
                .contains("\"permittedActivities\":[\"INTERVIEW\"]")
                .contains("\"soundRecordingSuitable\":true")
                .contains("No smoke effects")
                .contains("3-phase power available")
                .contains("Do not claim current availability")
                .contains("available for the exact requested interval 2026-08-25 10:00-16:00")
                .contains("Do not judge or claim a total budget fit")
                .contains("Do not claim excellent acoustics");
        assertThat(prompt.getValue()).doesNotContain("ownerEmail");
    }
```

### Copy and financial terminology checklist

| Term | Required distinction |
|---|---|
| Request / booking | REQUESTED is a stored request, not paid/confirmed or a reserved slot. Review current expiry email saying “No booking was created” against this distinction. |
| Accepted / confirmed | Owner acceptance means AWAITING_PAYMENT; only authoritative successful payment confirms. |
| Payment / refund | Checkout/redirect is not payment proof; initiated/queued/processing refund is not completed or bank-settled. |
| Venue price / total paid | Booking snapshot versus actually received amount; never browser-controlled money. |
| Commission / provider fee | Eema percentage on authoritative retained amount versus actual reconciled provider cost. Unknown fee is not a zero-fee claim. |
| Owner payout / retained amount | Owner net entitlement after deductions versus amount not returned to scout. |
| CALCULATED / HELD / READY / PAID | Calculation and readiness are not external transfer. Mark paid records a transfer and does not send money. |
| Receipt / statement | Payment record versus owner payout record; neither presented as tax invoice. |
| Owner verification / venue review / payout destination review | Separate manual trust decisions; not automated KYC, identity proof or bank ownership proof. |
| Incident / cancellation | Incident review has no automatic financial or venue effect. |
| Policy review / privacy acknowledgement | Exact published versions; final approved privacy semantics remain business/legal input. |

Apply table to every UI state, notification, PDF and admin action; contradictory financial/trust copy fails the parent scenario. No automation or documentation should silently choose missing legal/business rules.

<a id="automated-coverage"></a>

The backend CI has fast `mvn test`, independent PostgreSQL `mvn verify -Ppostgres-integration`, and package after both. Frontend package scripts provide typecheck/lint/build; no test runner, browser suite or frontend CI workflow was found in the inspected repository. <a id="gaps"></a>
## TEST COVERAGE / PRODUCT GAPS DISCOVERED

These are source-observed limitations or focused validation hypotheses, not changes made by this task. Severity is proposed test priority; product/security/operations owners must decide acceptance. Source characterization may pass while the corresponding release acceptance remains FAIL/BLOCKED.

| Gap | Priority | Source-observed behavior / hypothesis | Reproduction / coverage | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| G01 | P0 | Existing REQUESTED booking may be accepted after venue suspension: acceptRequest never checks ACTIVE and internal availability ignores status. | EDGE-004, BK-006, JOURNEY-007 | BookingService#acceptRequest; VenueAvailabilityService#getAvailableIntervalsExcludingBooking |
| G02 | P0 | Password reset removes refresh tokens but issued access JWT remains valid until expiry; logout does not revoke refresh tokens. “Old sessions invalid” must distinguish these cases. | AUTH-007, AUTH-015, JOURNEY-008 | AccountRecoveryService; JwtAuthenticationFilter; AuthProvider |

<a id="regression"></a>
## Regression packs and recommended automation order


Durations assume prepared fixtures and healthy environments; a failed gate stops release even if the time box expires. Do not force all P0 tests into a short smoke pack.

| Pack | Ordered subset / evidence |
|---|---|
| 10-minute smoke | Health (SEC-006), login/reload (AUTH-005/007), active catalogue/detail (VEN-008), read own booking and deny another (BK-008), admin exceptions read (ADMIN), one mocked request→accept check (BK-001/005) on prepared local fixtures. Production uses only read-only subset. |
| 30-minute pre-commit/manual | Smoke + policy gate (POL-004), owner verification/readiness/submission (TRUST-001, READY, VEN-009), inquiry offer/accept (INQ-002/003), checkout boundary (PAY-001/002), cancel preview (CANCEL-003), receipt authorization (DOC-001), one mobile/keyboard route UX check. Run relevant Java tests separately. |
| 2-hour release regression | Prepared JOURNEY-001/002/005/006/009; cancellation 100/50/0 and owner/admin; late payment/duplicate webhook; destination replacement/READY snapshot/mark-paid; incident isolation; one bad actor per admin controller; PostgreSQL suite; all changed-route error/responsive checks. Full suite if high-risk changes. |
| Full staging rehearsal | All P0/P1 and all STAGING provider cases; every route UX checklist, schema validation, backup/restore, restart, cross-origin/TLS, secret-log audit, exception/job recovery, legal/support gate. P2/P3 findings require disposition before beta. |

Highest-priority manual sequence: prepare identities and current test policies → verify owner and listing → scout request → owner acceptance plus competing request → mocked or approved TEST payment and duplicate webhook → late payment/full refund → cancellation boundary/partial refund → private receipt access → destination verification/READY snapshot/mark-paid statement → incident isolation → expired session/ownership attacks → restore and operations. Use the JOURNEY IDs for full step sequences, and keep provider proof separate from mocked assertions.

Do not implement Playwright as part of this task. Recommended future automation order:

1. Preserve fast Java unit + PostgreSQL suites and add actual HTTP role/ownership checks for every API row, especially newer policy/incident/destination controllers. Add service-level transaction races beyond raw SQL guarantees.
2. Build a controlled provider test harness and deterministic fixture reset/clock boundary; then browser auth/register/verify/login/refresh/logout and policy gating.
3. Browser scout request→owner accept→checkout boundary→authoritative confirmed view with provider mocked; competing requests and late payment remain primarily API/integration tests plus small UI assertions.
4. Browser owner verification→venue editor/photos/readiness→moderation, inquiries, and stale-state refetch.
5. Browser cancellation preview/confirmation and receipt permission; exact cancellation/price permutations stay table-driven Java/API tests.
6. Browser payout destination reveal clearing/replacement, READY snapshot/mark-paid/statement and incident review; bank crypto/uniqueness/ledger remain integration/unit.
7. Error/offline/malformed response, responsive/a11y automation for all routes; manual keyboard/screen-reader/copy/design and real-provider delivery remain explicit human/staging work.

For each future automated browser test, assert observable business outcome and backend state, not a brittle sequence of DOM implementation details. Keep real Mollie/Resend/Gemini/S3 tests sandboxed and separately scheduled; do not make unit CI depend on provider availability. Exact money, token races, exclusion constraints and worker locks should remain lower-level tests, not browser timing races.


<a id="alpha-gate"></a>
## Private-alpha acceptance gate

Allowed status for each row: **PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT RUN**. All rows below are **NOT RUN** at plan creation. A gate needs named tester, evidence and accountable reviewer. P0 FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT RUN prevents alpha; business/infrastructure uncertainty is not waived by passing mocks. Any exception requires explicit accountable release decision recorded outside this document, not an automatic approval.

| Category | Acceptance item | Required coverage | Status | Evidence / owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FUNCTIONAL | All current P0/P1 marketplace journeys and state/ownership transitions executed; no undefined workflow outcome. | JOURNEY, BK, INQ, VEN, POL | NOT RUN | Unassigned / none |
| SECURITY | All endpoint roles/ownership, reset JWT limitation, uploads, document/IBAN confidentiality and token/log probes reviewed; dependency findings resolved or explicit controlled-release decision. | API, SEC, DEST; G01–G03/G18/G23 | NOT RUN | Unassigned / none |
| PAYMENT | Mollie TEST create/paid/duplicate/late refund/full/partial/zero cancellation evidence; no duplicate charge/refund; fee reporting limitation has operating procedure. | PAY, REF, CANCEL, PROVIDER-001/005 | NOT RUN | Unassigned / none |
| TRUST | Owner/venue/bank review verified; suspension acceptance gap resolved or explicit approved rule; audit and participant incident visibility correct. | TRUST, VEN, DEST, INC; G01 | NOT RUN | Unassigned / none |
| OPERATIONS | Jobs, exception queue/metric divergence, manual transfer recording, liabilities, provider ambiguity and lost email recovery have named operators and exercised runbooks. | JOB, OPS, PAYOUT, EMAIL | NOT RUN | Unassigned / none |
| UX | Every route tested at 375/768/1440; primary action, status, loading/empty/error, keyboard/focus and financial copy usable; no P0 accessibility defect. | UX, UXACT, copy table | NOT RUN | Unassigned / none |
| LEGAL/BUSINESS | Approved five policies, privacy semantics, insurance/retention and incident/refund/payout communications confirmed; no development placeholder publication. | POL, EMAIL-031; G09 | NOT RUN | Unassigned / none |
| INFRASTRUCTURE | Staging HTTPS/origins, production startup validation, DB/migrations, secret management, public/private storage, backup restore and restart validated. | OPS, SEC-004, PROVIDER-004 | NOT RUN | Unassigned / none |


### Before staging and before beta

Before staging: source inventory refreshed, fast tests and real PostgreSQL suite executed, common-only fresh database and local backup restore rehearsed, P0 local contracts reviewed, approved staging secrets/origins/test-provider accounts ready. Missing legal texts may allow an isolated engineer-only test fixture rehearsal, never a claim that private-alpha legal acceptance passed.

Before beta: repeat full gate after code changes; close or explicitly disposition all P2/P3; test representative supported desktop/mobile browsers (record Chrome/Firefox/Safari versions rather than assume support); longer multi-session race/soak and queue backlog runs; restore from managed backup/PITR and object-store failure; actual provider outages/reconciliation; approved retention, incident communications and support response ownership. Traffic targets, RTO/RPO, supported regions/browser versions and service levels require product/operations input and must not be invented. Add those measurable targets before marking the beta operational gate PASS.

Inventory reconciled: **24 backend controllers / 90 HTTP method-path endpoints**, **35 frontend pages / 1 Next server endpoint**, **33 Java enums / 176 declared values**, **6 scheduled methods**, **30 implemented email recipient/lifecycle variants** and one explicit unsupported-email case. Existing automation mapped: **235 named methods in 64 files**, including **13 real-Postgres methods**. Helpers/fixtures without @Test are dependencies, not counted tests.

Local-only primary tests = LOCAL MOCKED count; local real-Postgres primary = LOCAL REAL POSTGRES count; mandatory staging-only primary = STAGING count. LOCAL MOLLIE TEST is an optional execution alternative to sandbox payment scenarios, with zero tests requiring it exclusively. Private alpha is a gate/rehearsal environment, not a separate duplicate count. Production smoke is read-only subset, not another paid-flow count.

Provider-specific cases: PAY/REF (Mollie mock), EMAIL (Resend content), MATCH (Gemini mocked extraction/ranking), MEDIA/DOC (local/mock S3), CALA (Next server provider), and five explicit real STAGING PROVIDER cases. Existing AUTO provider methods supply exact assertions without implying live delivery. Security and concurrency counts are by explicit test-level tags; all API cases include the full four-role matrix and object variants. UX/design includes one complete parameterized checklist per page plus UXACT double-submit/session cases and journeys.

Verification performed for this document: inventory/set comparison for every controller mapping, every Next page/route, every Java enum (including nested lifecycle/payment-result enums), every @Scheduled method and named existing @Test method; all IDs/anchors and priority/environment counts checked; output contains only fictional fixture data and repository test fixtures, no environment secret values. `git diff --check` and the explicit untracked-file check `git diff --no-index --check /dev/null docs/EEMA_COMPLETE_TEST_MASTER_PLAN.md` reported no whitespace errors. Application tests/providers were not executed for this planning-only task.

Re-run inventory before each release: new endpoint/page/state/job/event/field must receive a test ID, dependencies and traceability mapping. **No inventoried implemented capability remains without a defined test; completion of this document does not mean those tests have been executed or that discovered gaps are launch-safe.**


### AUTH launch-fix follow-up — 2026-09-10

AUTH-001 through AUTH-015 were rerun: all15 LOCAL PASS. Argon2id resolved the historical AUTH-004/AUTH-014 BCrypt failure; cross-tab failures now preserve newer sessions; unfiltered admin booking search and all filter combinations pass real PostgreSQL. See [execution report](qa/AUTH_EXECUTION_REPORT.md) and [design/parameters](qa/AUTH_LAUNCH_FIXES.md).

**P1 owner stale-auth UX — RESOLVED:** required reads use non-secret session generations. A stale403 joins recovery or checks `/auth/me`; only successful generation change permits one retry. Genuine403 remains forbidden with owner-appropriate copy. Three browser recovery repetitions passed without reload, alongside real ownership denial and role guards. See [owner recovery report](qa/OWNER_AUTH_RECOVERY.md). Backend application code remained unchanged; no unrelated domain gate is marked PASS.
